title: Mattress for moses basket/ custom mattress
label: gear

posts.body:
Hi, I've been trying to search for mattresses for moses basket but to no avail. I've looked in the upscale mummy shops like mothercare etc.

I'll probably be using a moses basket when bb comes, however, this is a hand-me-down and I do want to get a new mattress for bb. 

I've also seen options where I get a slightly smaller rectangular shaped mattress and plonk it into the moses basket, using blankets to fill in the gap. But I don't really want to do that, unless I have no choice. 

Does anyone have any recommendations on where I can get a moses basket mattress? Or a custom mattress maker who will listen when I say I want the mattress in an oblong shape?

TIA!
